findings.rationale: Literate materialization uses only the source stem and process ID, then fs::write truncates any existing path and Drop unconditionally removes it. A stale path after PID reuse or same-process reentry for the same stem can therefore overwrite and later delete another invocation's or user's file; a pre-existing symlink can also redirect the write.

PROJECT_BLOCKS and the public documentation recognize evaluator and failure_mode as raw block boundaries, but RAW_BLOCKS omits both and parse_ai_project has no other match arm for them. Their declarations are silently discarded, after which the frontend can still return ai_project_analyzed, so accepted source is reported as checked without preserving those declared blocks.
